# GENERATED by network/refresh-sources.sh via
# network/resolve-zig-mirrors.py. Do not edit by hand.

# mise shuffles the community mirror list and tries each host in
# turn (src/plugins/core/zig.rs), so any of them can serve a given
# install and all of them have to be reachable.

# The Zig project itself: the mirror list, download/index.json for
# version resolution, and /builds/ for nightlies, which are not
# mirrored.
